title: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs in AI-driven push
script:
Five thousand jobs. Barclays is cutting them for AI.
Chief Executive Officer C.S. Venkatakrishnan is leading the restructuring across the British bank.
The lender expects efficiency measures to deliver savings of more than one billion pounds next year.
Automated systems and machine learning models will take over routine tasks previously done by staff.
Traditional banking roles in back office operations face the heaviest reductions.
Would you let an algorithm manage your bank account?
